scripts.predev: rm -rf .wrangler node_modules/.vite && pnpm fonts:og && pnpm headers && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.prebuild: rm -rf .wrangler node_modules/.vite && pnpm fonts:og && pnpm headers
scripts.deploy: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production sh -c 'pnpm -w exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config apps/website/wrangler.jsonc && pnpm -w exec wrangler deploy --config apps/website/wrangler.jsonc'
scripts.deploy:preview: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview sh -c 'pnpm -w exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config apps/website/wrangler.jsonc && pnpm -w exec wrangler deploy --config apps/website/wrangler.jsonc'
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm -w exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config apps/website/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.pretest: pnpm fonts:og && pnpm headers && pnpm db:migrate
